resolution.note: SessionStart injects docs/generated/capability-index.md (src module headers, krn commands); fast regenerates it, test checks it fresh; krn-lead skill says to grep it first.

title: The lead starts each session with KRN's own capability index
body:
Why: operator 2026-11-14: the lead did not know its own code twice in one session: it called a sandbox placeholder .mcp.json "not mine" although src/state/sandbox-placeholders.ts documents it, and it nearly missed that lane run already had a budget cap (t-zyqmqx2) and krn hook stop already existed. The lead answers from recall instead of from KRN.
Outcome: SessionStart gives the lead a generated capability index (one line per src module from its header comment, plus krn command table), and the lead skill says: before calling anything foreign, unknown or missing, grep the index and src; the index is regenerated by fast and checked fresh in CI.
Proof: a test that the index lists every src module with its header; a scripted replay where the lead prompt names .mcp.json in git status and the index line for sandbox-placeholders is in the SessionStart context; npm run fast PASS.
